name: What is the advantage of using one contractor for both finish carpentry and interior painting?

mainEntity.name: What is the advantage of using one contractor for both finish carpentry and interior painting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hiring a single contractor who provides both finish carpentry and interior painting ensures that all nail holes, miter joints, and caulk seams are prepped and coated seamlessly. When separate trades handle trim and paint, questions often arise about who is responsible for filling fastener holes, sanding joint seams, or caulking edges against drywall. A team that executes carpentry, drywall repair, and painting under one roof delivers uniform wall lines and avoids finger-pointing between trades, speeding up overall project completion and ensuring clean paint cut lines.
acceptedAnswer.description: A single contractor handles both carpentry and paint prep, eliminating trade handoff gaps and ensuring all nail holes, caulking, and edges finish cleanly.
